title: r/longevity on Reddit: What we know (and would still like to know) about current senolytic compounds:
abstract:
Yeah, I don't think it's feasible to get a senolytic level dose just by eating strawberries. You pretty much have to take pure fisetin.
Posted by u/AllegedlyImmoral - 25 votes and 45 comments
The first study to identify fisetin as an effective senolytic, Fisetin is a senotherapeutic that extends health and lifespan, used a dose in elderly mice of 100mg/kg/day for 5 days.
Yeah, I don't think it's feasible to get a senolytic level dose just by eating strawberries. You pretty much have to take pure fisetin.
There's a clinical trial using senolytic doses of fisetin in humans that is supposedly scheduled to be finished in June, so hopefully we will get a bit more useful evidence soon.
